extName.message: Mobile Simulator: Phone, Tablet, Laptop & Smart TV

extDescription.message: Real responsive testing: phone, tablet, laptop & TV mockups with realistic frames, touch, virtual keyboard, UA & FPS.

cmdReopenLast.message: Reopen the last device and URL in preview

panelSubtitle.message: Pick a device to preview the current tab’s site

footerPreview.message: Preview opens in the current tab, with a realistic frame.

footerShortcut.message: Shortcut: Alt+Shift+P reopens the last device

presetApplyTitle.message: Favorite the set and open the first device

ob1Body.message: Tap an iPhone or Pixel below — preview opens in the current tab with a realistic frame and that device’s User-Agent.

ob2Body.message: The current tab URL loads into the mockup automatically. If the tab is chrome:// or empty, we open a demo (Wikipedia).

ob3Body.message: In the preview bar: rotate, virtual keyboard when focusing a field, Capture PNG and FPS. Alt+Shift+P reopens the last device.

errDevices.message: Could not load the device list: $1$. Reload the extension at chrome://extensions.

errPreviewReload.message: Failed to open preview: $1$. Reload the extension at chrome://extensions.

btnFrameless.message: Fullscreen: hide the frame and show only the screen at device resolution (keeps aspect ratio)

btnStretch.message: Stretch: fill the window distorting aspect ratio (enables fullscreen)

btnBrowser.message: Browser bar: show Chrome/Safari chrome inside the mockup

btnTouch.message: Touch: the site receives touch events instead of mouse; drag scrolls; pointer becomes a finger (phones and tablets only)

addressPlaceholder.message: Enter a URL and press Enter

btnFps.message: FPS meter: measure frames per second of the embedded site.

btnReportTitle.message: Copy report (viewport, UA, FPS) for PR/Jira

btnExitTitle.message: Exit preview and return to the normal site

reviewBody.message: Did the capture help? A Chrome Web Store review boosts discovery for other developers.

toastOpenViaExt.message: Open this page from the extension (toolbar icon), not as a local file.

toastStretchOn.message: Stretched: fills the window (distorts aspect ratio)

toastCaptureExtOnly.message: Capture is only available from the extension.

toastFpsExtOnly.message: FPS meter is only available from the extension.

toastFpsNeedSite.message: Load a site before measuring FPS.

toastFpsUnavailable.message: Measurement unavailable for $1$. Reload the extension at chrome://extensions.

toastReportCopied.message: Report copied — paste into PR or Jira

toastReportFail.message: Could not copy; check the console for the text

toastTouchDesktop.message: This device is used with a mouse — touch stays off.

toastTouchOn.message: Touch on: drag to scroll, like on a real device.

toastTouchOff.message: Touch off: the site receives mouse events again.

reportFpsMissing.message: (turn on the FPS meter in the toolbar to include)
